quotes.name: Talas Air Ship
quotes.flavor:
"Their ships pollute our air as they themselves pollute our forest."
—Arathel, elvish queen

quotes.name: Egon, God of Death // Throne of Death
quotes.flavor: Egon ages backward, his wisdom soured by youthful spite.

quotes.name: Mental Journey
quotes.flavor: "My wandering mind has always been an asset."

quotes.name: Bribery
quotes.flavor: "It seems your ticket is in order after all, ma'am."

quotes.name: Decimator Web
quotes.flavor: Mycosynth grew unfettered beneath the black lacuna, metastasizing into a matrix of noxious energy.

quotes.name: Verity Circle
quotes.flavor:
"Here, there is only truth."
—Barvisa, Azorius emissary

quotes.name: Parasitic Grasp
quotes.flavor: Some wicked souls linger only to consume the warmth of life.

quotes.name: Laquatus's Champion
quotes.flavor: Chainer's dark gift to a darker soul.

quotes.name: Inquisitor Exarch
quotes.flavor:
"Skin is the prison of the blessed and the stronghold of the heretic."
—Argent Etchings, plate 64, passage 17

quotes.name: Mystic Decree
quotes.flavor:
"Curse Reveka, and curse her coddled conjurers. Their sorcerers' school shall yet be ours."
—Irini Sengir

quotes.name: Kessig Wolf Run
quotes.flavor: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

quotes.name: Outlaws' Fury
quotes.flavor: The only witness to their rampage was the stoic visage of the moon.

quotes.name: Unstable Experiment
quotes.flavor:
"The solution is turning green! But . . . why? What does it mean?"
—Norman Osborn

quotes.name: Ultimecia, Temporal Threat
quotes.flavor:
"Ultimecia is a fearful sorceress. Her heart is filled with anger and hate."
—Edea Kramer

quotes.name: Squire
quotes.flavor:
"Of twenty yeer of age he was, I gesse.
Of his stature he was of even lengthe,
And wonderly deliver, and greete of strengthe."
—Geoffrey Chaucer, *The Canterbury Tales*

quotes.name: Goblin Negotiation
quotes.flavor: Either you pay for Krenko's "protection" or you pay to replace your stall. Either way, you pay.

quotes.name: Sigil Blessing
quotes.flavor: "For unwavering commitment and unflinching strength, the Order of the White Orchid confers its sigil. Rise, knight-captain, and do your duty."

quotes.name: Void Rend
quotes.flavor: Bits of the missing agent were discovered in various alleys across all three boroughs.

quotes.name: Travel Preparations
quotes.flavor: Visiting a shrine at the start of a journey makes the traveler more likely to finish it.

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Silvergill Adept
quotes.flavor: "If you keep to the shallows, you'll never learn the secrets of the depths."

quotes.name: Fire Urchin
quotes.flavor: Rain runoff in the Smelting District is known to spontaneously burst into flame.

quotes.name: Order of Whiteclay
quotes.flavor: Made from the clay of burial mounds, the face paint of the priests is a sign of their respect for those whose rest they interrupt.

quotes.name: Suntail Hawk
quotes.flavor: Its eye the glaring sun, its cry the keening wind.

quotes.name: Bladetusk Boar
quotes.flavor: Those who dare stand in its path are either brave or mindless. Or in the case of goblins, both.

quotes.name: Lowland Giant
quotes.flavor: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth. "Why would it make a meal of something like you?" Squee looked relieved. "No," he continued, "you'd make a much better toothpick."

quotes.name: Kor Hookmaster
quotes.flavor: "For us, a rope represents the ties that bind the kor. For you, it's more literal."

quotes.name: Ravenous Slime
quotes.flavor: Death eventually wiggles toward us all.

quotes.name: Mobilization
quotes.flavor: Newcomers to Otaria find themselves at the bottom of the heap. In the pits, they at least have the chance to climb atop a heap of bodies.

quotes.name: Mindswipe
quotes.flavor:
"The past and the unwritten are frozen. To understand their meaning requires heat."
—Arel the Whisperer

quotes.name: Treasure Vault
quotes.flavor: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

quotes.name: Gainsay
quotes.flavor:
"I'd be happy to stop contradicting you, Urza, just as soon as you start being right."
—Bo Levar, planeswalker

quotes.name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
quotes.flavor: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

quotes.name: Purphoros's Intervention
quotes.flavor: "I bring a fire to recast all the world."

quotes.name: Sinew Sliver
quotes.flavor: As the muscle cords of the creature twitched, Hanna saw an unsettling unanimity in the others' rippling flesh. She didn't know what it meant, but she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

quotes.name: Unholy Strength
quotes.flavor: Such power grows the body as it shrinks the soul.

quotes.name: Besotted Knight // Betroth the Beast
quotes.flavor: "You are no monster to me, my love."

quotes.name: Safewright Cavalry
quotes.flavor: They had survived battles and foes together. For the elf, there was no greater beauty than her cervin steed.

quotes.name: Woodland Chasm
quotes.flavor:
"Is this the grave of a god? A tunnel carved by the Cosmos Serpent? It matters not. It is no place for us."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

quotes.name: Spotcycle Scouter
quotes.flavor: Hard light. Hard attitude.

quotes.name: Darkwater Catacombs
quotes.flavor: The mirelurks seem significantly happier here than the commuters were.

quotes.name: Llanowar Visionary
quotes.flavor: The elves of Llanowar look to their past to determine the shape of their future.

quotes.name: Hollow Dogs
quotes.flavor: A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.

quotes.name: Mobilized District
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.

quotes.name: Might of the Masses
quotes.flavor: The Joraga elves never need ask a troll to leave their territory. They merely grant it their combined strength, and it can't resist embarking on a merry rampage.

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: She died in this swamp, and so will you.

quotes.name: Pitchstone Wall
quotes.flavor: Its material may not be precious, but the minds it protects are.

quotes.name: Manifold Key
quotes.flavor:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

quotes.name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
quotes.flavor: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

quotes.name: Tamiyo's Journal
quotes.flavor: Entry 434: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

quotes.name: Hull Breach
quotes.flavor: At the lash of the hive ship's feeder tentacles, the cruiser vented atmosphere, cargo, and crew members into the void.

quotes.name: Sporemound
quotes.flavor:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

quotes.name: Deepchannel Duelist
quotes.flavor:
"He flourished his blade, and the Wanderwine flourished, too. To this day, he's still felt in every current."
—*The Legend of Flynn*

quotes.name: Zagoth Triome
quotes.flavor: Hunters in the primeval wetlands become fluent in reading the ripples to tell when to pursue and when to flee.

quotes.name: Bone Shards
quotes.flavor: In the Kathari dumping grounds known as the Boneheaps, its not hard to improvise an offense.

quotes.name: Faramir, Steward of Gondor
quotes.flavor: "The last Steward of Gondor begs leave to surrender his office."

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

quotes.name: Fiery Islet
quotes.flavor:
"We'll use this ship as a battering ram to hit all of the others, creating a massive temporal reaction. Takes the ships, and all the Sontarans on Earth, out of existence. Huge temporal bang."
—Karvanista

quotes.name: Tokka & Rahzar, Terrible Twos
quotes.flavor: "Master say have fun!"

quotes.name: Wall of Diffusion
quotes.flavor:
"The injury was being caught between this world and our own; the insult was to find walls within."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

quotes.name: Pyroblast
quotes.flavor:
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Basilica Guards
quotes.flavor: "None may pass . . . for free."

quotes.name: Dark Favor
quotes.flavor: When he began to curse what he held holy, his strength grew unrivaled.

quotes.name: Food Fight
quotes.flavor: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.

quotes.name: Norn's Wellspring
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Drown, so you may breathe again."
—Atraxa

quotes.name: Verdant Force
quotes.flavor: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

quotes.name: Bone Splinters
quotes.flavor:
"Which do you deserve, the heft of a femur or the graceful sharpness of a forearm? Decisions, decisions . . ."
—Gisa the Mad

quotes.name: Pulse of Murasa
quotes.flavor: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

quotes.name: Wurm's Tooth
quotes.flavor: Jevna Nor lugged it around, bragging of his triumph over the wurm. Luckily, the tavern regulars didn't notice it was only a baby tooth.

quotes.name: Ravenous Giant
quotes.flavor: The might of an army with the restraint of a child.

quotes.name: Stitcher's Supplier
quotes.flavor: No part goes to waste.

quotes.name: Court of Grace
quotes.flavor: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

quotes.name: Pyre Charger
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor: His blade was forged over coals of moaning treefolk, curved at the optimum angle for severing heads, and heated to volcanic temperatures by his touch.

quotes.name: Feast on the Fallen
quotes.flavor: He only paused to catch his breath, not knowing that it would be his last.

quotes.name: Ichorspit Basilisk
quotes.flavor: Warm forges and tasty goblins lured it from the Hunter Maze to the Quiet Furnace.

quotes.name: Cleansing Wildfire
quotes.flavor: Every rebirth looks like a death.

quotes.name: Underworld Coinsmith
quotes.flavor: Coins of the Underworld are shaped from clay funerary masks.

quotes.name: Empty the Warrens
quotes.flavor: It's never just *one* goblin.

quotes.name: Waterlogged Grove
quotes.flavor: The trees pull water from deep underground, filling the forest for miles.

quotes.name: Eureka Moment
quotes.flavor: "At first, the equations were simply numbers. But in those numbers I saw a story, and in that story I saw a pattern, and suddenly it all fit together!"

quotes.name: Guttersnipe
quotes.flavor:
"I'm not sure we can outlast them, Captain. Their ammunition appears to be lava, Captain."
—Stubert, pirate gunner

quotes.name: Ranger of Eos
quotes.flavor: At his side, humble beasts become weapons more deadly than sharpened steel.

quotes.name: Pit Fight
quotes.flavor:
"All the coins in Ravnica can't save his soul now."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Everything is in progress . . . just like us. May we always know exactly who we are."
—Jace, to Tam

quotes.name: Tukatongue Thallid
quotes.flavor: Jund's thallids tried to disguise their deliciousness by covering themselves in spines harvested from the tukatongue tree.

quotes.name: Court Street Denizen
quotes.flavor: "The Boros fight for justice. The Azorius fight for law. I hold the line between, and make sure the people are given both."

quotes.name: Scryb Sprites
quotes.flavor: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

quotes.name: Viper's Kiss
quotes.flavor:
"I could heal a snakebite. Looks like you got bitten by a constellation."
—Aescalos, healer of Pharika

quotes.name: Boartusk Liege
quotes.flavor: The boar leads its rider to victory in battle, but it doesn't know how close it is to becoming the victory feast.

quotes.name: Growth Spiral
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

quotes.name: Second Thoughts
quotes.flavor: It suddenly dawned on Jorin that farming was quite a noble profession.

quotes.name: Murderous Cut
quotes.flavor: The blades of a Sultai assassin stab like the fangs of a dragon.

quotes.name: Dingus Egg
quotes.flavor: Legend has it that the world was hatched from a dingus egg.

quotes.name: Talisman of Conviction
quotes.flavor:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Stronghold Zeppelin
quotes.flavor: As long as the stronghold controlled the sky, the rebels were doomed.

quotes.name: Zoetic Cavern
quotes.flavor: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

quotes.name: Morkrut Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Midnight Haunting
quotes.flavor: The path back to the world of the living is murky and bewildering. A geist may not even realize that it's terrifying its own loved ones.

quotes.name: Narset's Reversal
quotes.flavor:
"In the disarray of battle, an enemy's attack may be your most convenient weapon."
—Narset

quotes.name: Soaring Lightbringer
quotes.flavor: Hope arrives on silent wings.

quotes.name: Tocatli Honor Guard
quotes.flavor: The glorious city of Pachatupa is the center of the Sun Empire, and Tocatli, the emperor's palace, is its glowing heart.

quotes.name: Novice Knight
quotes.flavor: Even the greatest hero begins with nothing.

quotes.name: Infernal Captor
quotes.flavor: Possession is nine-tenths of the law. His fist is the other tenth.

quotes.name: It That Heralds the End
quotes.flavor:
"At first we ignored the little ones. By the time we realized our error, it was too late."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Armillary Sphere
quotes.flavor: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

quotes.name: Seat of the Synod
quotes.flavor: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

quotes.name: Gilt-Leaf Archdruid
quotes.flavor: "In our hands, the natural world finds more beauty than nature alone could ever provide."

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Shield Bearer
quotes.flavor:
"You have almost completed your four years, my son. Soon you shall be a skyknight."
—Arna Kennerüd, skyknight

quotes.name: Flashfreeze
quotes.flavor:
"Nature? Fire? Bah! Both are chaotic and difficult to control. Ice is structured, latticed, light as a feather, massive as a glacier. In ice, there is power!"
—Heidar, Rimewind master

quotes.name: Anaconda
quotes.flavor: If you're smaller than the anaconda, it considers you food. If you're larger than the anaconda, it considers you a lot of food.

quotes.name: Regal Imperiosaur
quotes.flavor: Initially frustrated by Muraganda's inconsistent biodiversity, Avishkari researchers made a breakthrough after mapping the plane's aetheric index—the wide variety of fauna was the result of raw magic, not evolution.

quotes.name: Chicken à la King
quotes.flavor: During the Chicken Revolution, the king managed to keep his head while the others—well, just ran around.

quotes.name: Mentor's Guidance
quotes.flavor: Kasmina had encouraged the twins to apply. Strixhaven would test not only their magical potential, but also their character.

quotes.name: Star-Crowned Stag
quotes.flavor: White as starlight on snow, it appears only on the eve of the winter solstice.

quotes.name: Energizer
quotes.flavor: Like a kettle set to boil, it must eventually go off—on someone.

quotes.name: Raiders' Wake
quotes.flavor: One was spared to tell the gruesome tale.

quotes.name: Amazing Alliance
quotes.flavor:
"You know, we should really do this more often."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

quotes.name: Overgrowth
quotes.flavor:
"Let the forest spread! From salt, stone, and fen, let the new trees rise."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

quotes.name: Ruinous Ultimatum
quotes.flavor:
"It was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes."
—Caesar

quotes.name: Skeleton Archer
quotes.flavor:
"When it comes to killing with precision, a soul is but a hindrance."
—Isareth the Awakener

quotes.name: Boros Elite
quotes.flavor:
"First, you must fight among the rank and file. It is there I will discern your skills as a leader."
—Aurelia, to Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Roc of Kher Ridges
quotes.flavor: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and sprouted gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

quotes.name: Skeletal Scrying
quotes.flavor: His family was a small price to pay for the dark gifts that called to him.

quotes.name: Your Will Is Not Your Own
quotes.flavor: "Fool. I'll show you how to use that thing."

quotes.name: Thriving Bluff
quotes.flavor: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

quotes.name: Hurloon Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

quotes.name: Soldevi Digger
quotes.flavor:
"This ceaseless device has helped uncover marvels unreachable by mere flesh."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

quotes.name: Xathrid Necromancer
quotes.flavor: "My commands shall echo forever in their dusty skulls."

quotes.name: Palace Sentinels
quotes.flavor:
"One who ruled willing subjects would need no such protection."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

quotes.name: Charging Paladin
quotes.flavor: "Hope shall be the blade that severs our bonds."

quotes.name: Cleansing Nova
quotes.flavor: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

quotes.name: Spellbound Dragon
quotes.flavor: A king in Jund, a serf in Esper.

quotes.name: Spreading Insurrection
quotes.flavor: Everyone wants to be on the winning side.

quotes.name: Shadow of the Goblin
quotes.flavor: "It's time, Harry. Take the mask and avenge me."

quotes.name: Greater Good
quotes.flavor:
"There's wisdom to be gained in death—whether it be one's own or someone else's."
—Jarad, Golgari Lich-Lord

quotes.name: Bone Saw
quotes.flavor: Once a simple tool, it—like everything else on Zendikar—has been turned into a weapon against the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Twinscroll Shaman
quotes.flavor: "May your wretched name never grace the annals of history, you ignorant buffoon!"

quotes.name: Surrak and Goreclaw
quotes.flavor: Two titans of Tarkir carved a swath through Phyrexia's elite.

quotes.name: Empty the Warrens
quotes.flavor:
"They'd pour out of the warrens to make war (and to make room for the littering matrons)."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Armillary Sphere
quotes.flavor: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

quotes.name: Levitation
quotes.flavor: "We'll be easy targets if we remain on the ground. Let's take the fight to them."

quotes.name: Thirst for Knowledge
quotes.flavor: Raissa transformed herself into a vessel for the Watchword Codex, allowing the arcane lore to flow through her body.

quotes.name: Urza's Chalice
quotes.flavor: When sorely wounded or tired, Urza would often retreat to the workshops of his apprentices. They were greatly amazed at how much better he looked each time he took a sip of water.

quotes.name: Dual Shot
quotes.flavor: "Through me the rage of Tilonalli burns twice as bright."

quotes.name: Hero's Blade
quotes.flavor: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

quotes.name: Redoubled Stormsinger
quotes.flavor: "Blink or don't. You'll get hit either way."

quotes.name: Brassclaw Orcs
quotes.flavor:
"The Brassclaws delighted in lightning raids on Icatian and Dwarven towns; an unprepared enemy is easier to defeat."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Trained Armodon
quotes.flavor: Armodons are trained to step on things. Enemy things.

quotes.name: Sinew Dancer
quotes.flavor: To resist the embrace of the Flesh Singularity is to reject unconditional acceptance.

quotes.name: Windstorm
quotes.flavor:
"We don't like interlopers and thieves cluttering our skies."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

quotes.name: Stormblood Berserker
quotes.flavor: Blood is holy to those whose god is War.

quotes.name: Winter's Intervention
quotes.flavor: "Can we trust him?" Niko whispered as they eyed the stranger. "I don't know," the Wanderer replied, "but he's a lot friendlier than the creature that was chasing us."

quotes.name: Thran Golem
quotes.flavor: Karn felt more secure about his value to Urza when he realized he didn't need regular trimming.

quotes.name: Highborn Vampire
quotes.flavor: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.

quotes.name: Saber Ants
quotes.flavor: They stay on the battlefield only long enough to consume the losers.

quotes.name: Namor, Atlantean King
quotes.flavor: "IMPERIUS REX!"

quotes.name: Abattoir Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Death took his humanity but not his skill with the knife.

quotes.name: Taunt from the Rampart
quotes.flavor:
"Wotta revoltin' development."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

quotes.name: Carrion Thrash
quotes.flavor: Viashino hunt in gangs called thrashes. Not all thrashes hunt the freshest game.

quotes.name: Harmonized Crescendo
quotes.flavor: A song can unite quicker than a sword can divide.

quotes.name: Packsong Pup
quotes.flavor: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.

quotes.name: Final-Word Phantom
quotes.flavor: "Just one more thing . . ."

quotes.name: Zodiac Monkey
quotes.flavor: ". . . By six offensives from the hills of Qi Kongming sought to change Han's destiny. . . ."

quotes.name: Illusionist's Bracers
quotes.flavor: It's easy to believe you're a god when you're twice as powerful as everyone else.

quotes.name: Shivan Reef
quotes.flavor: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

quotes.name: Frontline Medic
quotes.flavor: "The world is full enough of hurts and mischances without wars to multiply them."

quotes.name: Torment of Hailfire
quotes.flavor:
"Even with all the power in the world, you are still weak."
—Ozai, to Aang

quotes.name: Storm, Windrider
quotes.flavor: "Wind and lightning, hear my call!"

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

quotes.name: Coral Trickster
quotes.flavor: They wait in darkened depths, laughing eagerly.

quotes.name: Bloodtithe Collector
quotes.flavor: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

quotes.name: Cryptcaller Chariot
quotes.flavor:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur

quotes.name: Polyraptor
quotes.flavor: Imagination is a powerful source of magic, as dinosaurs are a powerful source of biting.

quotes.name: Unearth
quotes.flavor: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.

quotes.name: Eiganjo Free-Riders
quotes.flavor:
"The air filled with dust and the sound of wingbeats. The mothriders had joined the fray."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Stirge
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"I will never complain about mosquitos again."
—Imoen

quotes.name: Thraben Watcher
quotes.flavor:
"Fear not the angels' constant eyes,
E'er on watch from lightless skies;
Eternal vigil will we keep,
Protectors of the Blessed Sleep."

quotes.name: Pith Driller
quotes.flavor: After boring up through the crust of Mirrodin, it turned its expertise upon the surface dwellers.

quotes.name: Arms Race
quotes.flavor: "You want it good, fast, or cheap? You can't have all three."

quotes.name: Profane Procession // Tomb of the Dusk Rose
quotes.flavor: Vona sought a conqueror. Mavren sought a savior. Both found what they sought . . .

quotes.name: Clarion Conqueror
quotes.flavor: All challengers were summarily silenced.

quotes.name: Burglar Rat
quotes.flavor:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

quotes.name: Venerated Teacher
quotes.flavor: "The unfathomable is upon us, students. I have no doubt you will rise to the occasion."

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor: Chaos renegades always seek to deface and destroy effigies of Imperial piety, replacing them with blasphemous symbols of the Ruinous Powers.

quotes.name: Satyr Hoplite
quotes.flavor: "Xenagos has become what he once despised: a tyrant and an oppressor."

quotes.name: Bloodsoaked Altar
quotes.flavor: Blood seeps into the stone, and darkness emerges.

quotes.name: Ridgeline Rager
quotes.flavor: While armies battled across Jamuraa, beasts stalked the high places looking for victims.

quotes.name: Carnival Hellsteed
quotes.flavor: Its favorite treats are candied hands and sweet hearts.

quotes.name: Lotus Cobra
quotes.flavor: Its scales contain the essence of thousands of lotus blooms.

quotes.name: Deserted Beach
quotes.flavor:
"By Silencio Lake. On the Plain of Sighs. An impossible astronaut will rise from the deep. And strike the Time Lord dead."
—Madame Kovarian

quotes.name: Simic Locket
quotes.flavor:
"Like our guild itself, this locket can stand for many things. You must discern what it means for you."
—Vannifar

quotes.name: Deadbridge Goliath
quotes.flavor: Some Golgari insects live for centuries-and they never stop growing.

quotes.name: Strategic Planning
quotes.flavor: Alrund sees the future as a whorl of signs and symbols, omens interwoven in an intricate knotwork only he can decipher.

quotes.name: Search for Azcanta // Azcanta, the Sunken Ruin
quotes.flavor: The Sunken Ruin houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

quotes.name: Cabal Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"The Demonlord has ruled every age. Every ruin, myth, and nightmare proves his power."
—"Rite of Belzenlok"

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Some cars have a combustion engine, a combustion windshield, and a combustion steering wheel too.

quotes.name: Reckless Assault
quotes.flavor:
"How will you fight an enemy that cares nothing for itself?"
—The Blind Seer

quotes.name: Crow of Dark Tidings
quotes.flavor:
"Well, this can't be a good sign."
—Old Rutstein

quotes.name: Masked Meower
quotes.flavor: Neither criminals nor veterinarians had much luck pinning down the uncatchable Spider-Cat.

quotes.name: Goblin Trailblazer
quotes.flavor:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, *Diremore* first mate

quotes.name: Murmuring Mystic
quotes.flavor: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor:
"Hunger is no different from any other foe; defeat it in the Emperor's name, and save Humanity."
—Motto of the Agri-World Viridia IV

quotes.name: Yargle and Multani
quotes.flavor:
"I've heard much about you from my daughter," Multani rumbled. "There was a time when I'd balk at your aid, phantom, but she has shown me the merit in Urborg's strange ways."
"Gnshhagghkkapphribbit," replied Yargle.

quotes.name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
quotes.flavor: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

quotes.name: Radstorm
quotes.flavor: Green sky at night, ghoul's delight.

quotes.name: Carven Caryatid
quotes.flavor: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.

quotes.name: Vital Splicer
quotes.flavor:
"For every one that falls, ten shall rise. The revelation of New Phyrexia is at hand."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

quotes.name: Invoke the Ancients
quotes.flavor: After large sections were clear-cut to build Towashi, the once-peaceful Jukai Forest grew violently hostile to outsiders.

quotes.name: Drowned Catacomb
quotes.flavor:
"The living goddess Amdo sees and hears all."
—Ramo

quotes.name: West Coast Expansion
quotes.flavor:
"You know, not every caper takes place in New York."
—Hawkeye, Clint Barton

quotes.name: Morkrut Necropod
quotes.flavor:
"There's not enough salt in all of Nephalia to wither that thing."
—Ghoulcaller Enslow

quotes.name: War Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"The Houses always hope for peace, but we always pack for war."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar commander

quotes.name: Grafdigger's Cage
quotes.flavor:
"Best bury them right. We don't want any gruesome encores."
—Constable Trosk

quotes.name: Merfolk Looter
quotes.flavor: In the depths of Rootwater, salvage and sewage differ only in texture.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: No matter how big the fall is, you're safe as long as you land with both feet.

quotes.name: Invoke Despair
quotes.flavor: Although officials said it was a sewer failure, the people whispered that it was a warning of night's reach.

quotes.name: Fiery Impulse
quotes.flavor: "Well, this got out of hand."

quotes.name: Fulgent Distraction
quotes.flavor:
"Channeling the white-hot power of all five suns creates a pretty good diversion."
—Yavash of the Accorders

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Gideon's Lawkeeper
quotes.flavor: "The essence of a lawful society is swift deterrence."

quotes.name: Eidolon of Philosophy
quotes.flavor: "And what did Erekastos teach us is the nature of the soul?"

quotes.name: Noggle Bandit
quotes.flavor: Noggles believe that they were the first race ever to walk Shadowmoor. They don't "steal." They just take back what's rightfully theirs.

quotes.name: Soltari Trooper
quotes.flavor:
"Dauthi blood is Soltari wine."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

quotes.name: Deeproot Elite
quotes.flavor: "You think I stand alone? I have the forest at my call, the waters at my back. I outnumber you."

quotes.name: Kami of the Painted Road
quotes.flavor: In ancient times, precepts of kami law were inscribed onto bridges as a gesture of respect. During the war, humans regarded them as warnings of where not to travel.

quotes.name: Saruman, the White Hand
quotes.flavor: Over all his works a dark smoke hung and wrapped itself about the sides of Orthanc.

quotes.name: Gerrard's Verdict
quotes.flavor: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

quotes.name: Selesnya Keyrune
quotes.flavor: A mark of unity when you want one; a fierce guardian when you need one.

quotes.name: Magus of the Future
quotes.flavor: Those gifted with the sight have one eye in the present and the other in the future.

quotes.name: Young Pyromancer
quotes.flavor: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

quotes.name: Silver Scrutiny
quotes.flavor: Karn's creation allowed him to monitor events across Dominaria—and everything he saw worried him.

quotes.name: Huatli's Snubhorn
quotes.flavor: Don't make the mistake of thinking blunt horns can't kill.

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Stirring Bard
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: At the first sign of danger, she breaks out the power chords.

quotes.name: Scavenger Folk
quotes.flavor: String, weapons, wax, or jewels—it makes no difference. Leave nothing unguarded in Scarwood.

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

quotes.name: Mouth of Ronom
quotes.flavor:
"We shall meet bitter cold, if not worse, before we come down on the other side. It will not help us to keep so secret that we are frozen to death."
—Boromir

quotes.name: Dauntless Escort
quotes.flavor: Elspeth's squires do not seek advancement. For them, no knightly glory could surpass the glory of serving their champion.

quotes.name: Salvation Engine
quotes.flavor:
"The Guidelight Voyagers seem to exhibit more humanity than their flesh-and-blood competitors."
—Pia Nalaar

quotes.name: River Merfolk
quotes.flavor:
"Dwelling in icy mountain streams near goblin and orcish foes, the river merfolk were known for their stoicism."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

quotes.name: Leonin Sun Standard
quotes.flavor: The commander tells the troops where to go, but the standard reminds them why they're there.

quotes.name: Natural Order
quotes.flavor: . . . but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

quotes.name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
quotes.flavor: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

quotes.name: Blighted Bat
quotes.flavor: Amonkhet's dual suns don't allow for the darkness of night, so bats are most active under the gloom of the frequent sandstorms.

quotes.name: Sisay's Ring
quotes.flavor:
"With this ring, you have friends in worlds you've never heard of."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Mothrider Patrol
quotes.flavor:
"Be proud, young pup! You've earned your wings. Rise and become the western wind."
—Swift-Arm, Golden-Tail headmaster

quotes.name: Dragonclaw Strike
quotes.flavor: Some had doubted the whisperers' choice of Eshki for Dragonclaw. None did so after witnessing her in battle.

quotes.name: Robo-Piñata
quotes.flavor: "I AM FILLED WITH DELICIOUS CANDY. I AM NOT A TRICK."

quotes.name: Jennika, Bad Apple Big Sister
quotes.flavor: "Splinter said that, once, ninjas defended the poor and the weak from power. We could be real ninjas. We can fight for the people!"

quotes.name: Chandra Nalaar // Chandra Nalaar
quotes.flavor:
Signature Magic: Pyromancy
Color Alignment: Red
Plane of Origin: Kaladesh
First Planeswalk: Regatha
Height: 5'6"
Holds league record for most bats incinerated.

quotes.name: Flameblade Angel
quotes.flavor: "You must pay for your sin in blood."

quotes.name: Coordinated Clobbering
quotes.flavor: Zimone's theory was that the fractalization of atmospheric aether would increase kinetic energy. Tyvar's theory was that if you hit cultists in the face really hard, they would fall down. They were both right.

quotes.name: Eivor, Wolf-Kissed
quotes.flavor: "My destiny is mine to weave."

quotes.name: Windborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

quotes.name: Cyber Conversion
quotes.flavor: "Do not fear. We will take your fear from you. You will be like us."

quotes.name: Skyward Eye Prophets
quotes.flavor: They lament the doom that is coming to Bant without realizing the part their own leaders have played in it.

quotes.name: Unlicensed Disintegration
quotes.flavor: "I'd stand back if I were you."

quotes.name: Paragon of Modernity
quotes.flavor: No true angels have been created since the founding of New Capenna, but artisans have learned to craft elegant facsimiles.

quotes.name: Shenanigans
quotes.flavor: Pricy baubles are no match for cheap tricks.

quotes.name: Monica Rambeau // Photon, Living Light
quotes.flavor: Above the city, she glows . . .

quotes.name: Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore
quotes.flavor: The highway of fear is the shortest route to defeat.

quotes.name: Big Play
quotes.flavor:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor: The remains of ancient civilizations litter the run-down land.

quotes.name: Death Frenzy
quotes.flavor: The crocodiles' putrid jaws swallow everything but the screams.

quotes.name: Scrounging Bandar
quotes.flavor: "It was right here a second ago . . ."

quotes.name: Moldervine Reclamation
quotes.flavor:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

quotes.name: Eyeblight Assassin
quotes.flavor: "Boggart blood disgusts me almost as much as the foul creatures themselves."

quotes.name: River Hoopoe
quotes.flavor:
"It's a cruel thing to give such a sad song to such a colorful creature."
—Sana, former Ahn-crop initiate

quotes.name: Armored Galleon
quotes.flavor:
"Information equals profits. Our merchants sell it, or our pirates use it."
—Jefan, Talas ship captain

quotes.name: Ezio, Blade of Vengeance
quotes.flavor: "Nothing is true. Everything is permitted."

quotes.name: Haunted Ridge
quotes.flavor: Swirling eddies of ash hide crumbling cliffs, treacherous drops, and the slavering maws of unknown evils.

quotes.name: Starfield Mystic
quotes.flavor: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

quotes.name: Harrow
quotes.flavor: No spot in nature is truly barren.

quotes.name: Unsubstantiate
quotes.flavor:
"Nicely done, Jace. You always were good at disappearing acts."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Haughty Djinn
quotes.flavor: "I adore your outfit. It's so . . . rustic."

quotes.name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
quotes.flavor: Neave Blacktalon is a single-minded hunter and slayer of the enemy's most powerful lords.

quotes.name: Simian Spirit Guide
quotes.flavor:
"It's rarely worth questioning where the mana comes from. Just be grateful."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: The Wasp, Winsome Avenger
quotes.flavor: "No job too small. No villain too big."

quotes.name: Invoke the Divine
quotes.flavor:
"Let go of all that harms you. Cast your burdens into the darkness, and build for the faithful a house of light."
—*Song of All*, canto 1008

quotes.name: Twining Twins // Swift Spiral
quotes.flavor: "We spin and spin to keep us busy, but somehow you're the one who's dizzy."

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor:
"Without Urza's ingenuity, the wings would never have borne weight. Without Mishra's courage, we would never have known the machine's true potential. I hope this persuades them to work together more."
—Tocasia, journal entry

quotes.name: Rock Slide
quotes.flavor:
"Good ol' rock. Nothing beats rock."
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

quotes.name: Cloudkin Seer
quotes.flavor: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

quotes.name: Sentinel of the Nameless City
quotes.flavor: "Halt, traveler. Whatever you seek, you will not find it here."

quotes.name: Ghoul's Feast
quotes.flavor: Mercadians not wealthy enough to buy a tomb are thrown into a bog called "the Ghoul's Larder."

quotes.name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
quotes.flavor: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

quotes.name: Bog Imp
quotes.flavor: Don't be fooled by their looks. Think of them as little knives with wings.

quotes.name: Mutilate
quotes.flavor: Liliana developed a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.

quotes.name: Errand of Duty
quotes.flavor:
"Call every able sword to our side. Kjeldor will stand triumphant!"
—King Darien of Kjeldor

quotes.name: Wolf in _____ Clothing
quotes.flavor: "And to think, I came in here looking for someone to eat."

quotes.name: Knight of the Reliquary
quotes.flavor:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth

quotes.name: Anaconda
quotes.flavor: If you're smaller than the anaconda, it considers you food. If you're larger than the anaconda, it considers you a lot of food.

quotes.name: Urza's Mine
quotes.flavor: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

quotes.name: Pattern Matcher
quotes.flavor:
"Good! Now put it with the other widdle bunnies."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

quotes.name: Stronghold Assassin
quotes.flavor: The assassin sees only throats and hears only heartbeats.

quotes.name: Plover Knights
quotes.flavor: The knights are a major attraction at every Lammastide festival. Teams of riders perform daring feats of flight to the delight of all below.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: After using the signet to finish the miniaturization spell, the novice wizard realized they'd have big shoes to fill.

quotes.name: Putrid Leech
quotes.flavor: It reacted to Naya's overabundant food supply by growing additional mouths.

quotes.name: Aang, Air Nomad
quotes.flavor: Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.

quotes.name: Regal Bunnicorn
quotes.flavor:
"It's entirely peaceful, as long as you don't try to pet it, pen it, take its food, take its hide, sit on its grass, or dress it up in colorful garb for human holidays."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

quotes.name: Thriving Heath
quotes.flavor: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

quotes.name: Overwhelming Intellect
quotes.flavor: "My brain hurts."

quotes.name: Dragonlair Spider
quotes.flavor: Swarms thrive in its nest, feeding on leathery bits of discarded wing.

quotes.name: Whipkeeper
quotes.flavor: "If you don't hit your adversaries while they're down, they might get up again."

quotes.name: Compost
quotes.flavor:
A fruit must rot before its seed can sprout.
—Yavimaya saying

quotes.name: Overwhelmed Archivist // Archive Haunt
quotes.flavor: Cleaning up his life's work was his afterlife's work.

quotes.name: Eye of Duskmantle
quotes.flavor: Most thought the Dimir had been wiped out. This suited the Dimir perfectly.

quotes.name: Day of Judgment
quotes.flavor: Clerics on both sides prayed for divine intervention to end the war. The gods didn't play favorites.

quotes.name: Premature Burial
quotes.flavor:
"This soil knows well the taste of the dead. Give it the hunger for a living meal, and it can become a deadly ally."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

quotes.name: Giant Cockroach
quotes.flavor: Toren had stepped on a lot of bugs during his life, so he couldn't help feeling embarrassed when a bug stepped on him.

quotes.name: Gallant Strike
quotes.flavor: The ghost shrieked as Terrin's blade sank deep. Perhaps a second death would teach it not to mess with his dog.

quotes.name: Crimson Wisps
quotes.flavor: The whispers are incomprehensible, yet cinders always hear a message of urgency.

quotes.name: Tremor
quotes.flavor: Where do you run when the earth becomes your enemy?

quotes.name: Biomantic Mastery
quotes.flavor:
"Look beyond, to the vascular awareness that all life is a map to greater knowledge."
—Momir Vig, *Biomancy*, vol. I

quotes.name: Seeker of Skybreak
quotes.flavor:
"We shun them not for their dream but for their refusal to let such a noble dream die a noble death."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Ironshell Beetle
quotes.flavor:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Snowcrusher
quotes.flavor: Its plow wasn't designed for snow, but to carve a path through shrieking armies.

quotes.name: Mesmeric Orb
quotes.flavor: A step in one direction is two steps away from another.

quotes.name: Evolution Sage
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

quotes.name: Disorder
quotes.flavor:
"Then, just when the other guys were winnin', the sky threw up."
—Jula, goblin raider

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: It can chop down a redwood in a single stroke. Your sternum isn't going to fare any better.

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

quotes.name: Narstad Scrapper
quotes.flavor:
"Finally, the principles of corpse animation applied to bloodless materials!"
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

quotes.name: Barret Wallace
quotes.flavor: "You gonna stand there and pretend you can't hear the planet crying out in pain?"

quotes.name: Ironroot Warlord
quotes.flavor:
"Alone, it's a fortification. At the head of its troops, it's a battering ram."
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

quotes.name: Incite Rebellion
quotes.flavor: Nothing breaks the monotony like a good old-fashioned riot.

quotes.name: Hunger of the Howlpack
quotes.flavor:
"Werewolves are an unholy mix of a predator's instinct and a human's hatred."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

quotes.name: Burn Bright
quotes.flavor:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

quotes.name: Forlorn Pseudamma
quotes.flavor:
"More children taken. This is an evil we will track without mercy."
—Anthousa of Setessa

quotes.name: Aether Hub
quotes.flavor: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

quotes.name: Stoic Angel
quotes.flavor: Even the most battle-hardened soldiers pause in her presence for a moment of introspection.

quotes.name: Switcheroo
quotes.flavor: Say hello to your new friend.

quotes.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
quotes.flavor: Whatever knows fear burns at the Man-Thing's touch!

quotes.name: Rotten Reunion
quotes.flavor: Aunt and Uncle Greyfeld loved dinner guests.

quotes.name: Dragonsguard Elite
quotes.flavor: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."

quotes.name: About Face
quotes.flavor: The overconfident are the most vulnerable.

quotes.name: Sprouting Thrinax
quotes.flavor: The vast network of predation on Jund has actually caused some strange creatures to adapt to being eaten.

quotes.name: Mindleech Ghoul
quotes.flavor:
"This still doesn't make you the brains of the operation."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Flame-Kin Zealot
quotes.flavor: Boros soldiers are like a cache of bombs ready to explode, and the flame-kin light their fuses.

quotes.name: Voldaren Epicure
quotes.flavor: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

quotes.name: Feed the Clan
quotes.flavor: The Temur believe three things only are needed in life: a hot fire, a full belly, and a strong companion.

quotes.name: Benalish Hero
quotes.flavor: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

quotes.name: Child of Thorns
quotes.flavor:
"The soratami scoff at the perils of Jukai, calling the forest an 'unruly garden.' Perhaps we should send them a rose such as this."
—Dokai, Weaver of Life

quotes.name: Slave of Bolas
quotes.flavor: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

quotes.name: Acidic Slime
quotes.flavor: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

quotes.name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
quotes.flavor: The Machine Legion coveted her strength, but a spirit of sand, sun, and memory could never be *compleated*.

quotes.name: Ancient Craving
quotes.flavor:
"Knowledge demands sacrifice."
—Tojira, swamp queen

quotes.name: Release the Gremlins
quotes.flavor:
"Being an inventor means knowing how to use the tools at hand to make something great—or to bring it down."
—Pia Nalaar

quotes.name: Quicksilver Amulet
quotes.flavor: Those who examine the amulet too closely have been known to become part of its ornate carvings.

quotes.name: Sunforger
quotes.flavor: One of three treasures given by the Gods, found in the tail of an eight-headed dragon.

quotes.name: Fleshgrafter
quotes.flavor: Necrogen enflames certain emotional centers in the Morioks' brains: hate, aggression, and especially greed.

quotes.name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
quotes.flavor: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

quotes.name: Ancestral Communion
quotes.flavor:
"I am always here, my son. We all are."
—King T'Chaka

quotes.name: Tendrils of Agony
quotes.flavor:
Eternal Weekend
Legacy Championship 2025

quotes.name: Daru Lancer
quotes.flavor: Although the Order frowned upon his preparations for the pits, behind closed doors most saw the fights as a necessary evil.

quotes.name: Golgari Signet
quotes.flavor: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

quotes.name: Mutational Advantage
quotes.flavor: "Ow, my pipe!"

quotes.name: Finders, Keepers
quotes.flavor: The S.N.E.A.K. Code clearly permits looting corpses for parts. That just meant Agent 47.3 had to make sure her target was dead first.

quotes.name: Mistcaller
quotes.flavor: Hospitality is of little concern to those who do not wish to be disturbed.

quotes.name: Annex
quotes.flavor: You should see how small the map is.

quotes.name: Rubble Slinger
quotes.flavor:
"Tear down the city, lie by lie. Then throw it back at the liars, stone by stone."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Reconnaissance
quotes.flavor: War favors the informed.

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

quotes.name: Paraselene
quotes.flavor:
"Moonlight has a way of showing all things as they truly are—for better or for worse."
—Zilla of Lambholt

quotes.name: Benalish Hero
quotes.flavor: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

quotes.name: The Eighth Doctor
quotes.flavor: "Physician, heal thyself."

quotes.name: Heirloom Mirror // Inherited Fiend
quotes.flavor: "Speak my name thrice, and be rewarded."

quotes.name: Waste Away
quotes.flavor: Chainer's insanity touched nearly every living thing—including viruses.

quotes.name: Flaying Tendrils
quotes.flavor: Only one Eldrazi stood against them, yet the defenders were outnumbered.

quotes.name: Craven Giant
quotes.flavor:
What is high as a mountain and low as a snake?
—Dal riddle

quotes.name: Unsummon
quotes.flavor: Not to be. That is the answer.

quotes.name: Attended Knight
quotes.flavor: The virtues of knighthood are best taught in the field.

quotes.name: Villainous Wealth
quotes.flavor: Gold buys death. Death earns gold.

quotes.name: Goblin Snowman
quotes.flavor:
"Strength in numbers? Right."
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

quotes.name: Teferi's Ageless Insight // Teferi's Ageless Insight
quotes.flavor: "Okay, there are a few gaps in my knowledge."

quotes.name: Pearl Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"They knew Bantau was lost when, to hide the pearl he had found on the beach, he swallowed it—and soon grew wings."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

quotes.name: Tenacity
quotes.flavor: Thalia established the Order of Saint Traft in an effort to bring together cathars who would stand against the corruption of the Lunarch Council.

quotes.name: Azorius Signet
quotes.flavor: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

quotes.name: Ark of Hunger
quotes.flavor: Few relics survived the turmoil of the Blood Age; those that did are powerful, dangerous, or both.

quotes.name: Disinformation Campaign
quotes.flavor:
"People would sooner savor sweet lies than chew plain truths."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Nahiri's Wrath
quotes.flavor: "You brought this upon yourself, Sorin!"

quotes.name: Tiana, Ship's Caretaker
quotes.flavor: "Nothing is too broken to mend."

quotes.name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
quotes.flavor: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

quotes.name: Keepers of the Faith
quotes.flavor: And then the Archangel Anthius spoke to them, saying, "Fear shall be vanquished by the Sword of Faith."

quotes.name: Wrath of the Bloodmane
quotes.flavor: "I can see the weakness in your soul. Let me cut it out of you!"

quotes.name: Air Elemental
quotes.flavor: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild, and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

quotes.name: Wave Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"Consider the wave: how weak the mother yet how strong the child."
—Tywanna, Shaper Guildmage

quotes.name: Elixir of Vitality
quotes.flavor:
"Eternal life or your money back."
—Unnamed Suq'Ata merchant, deceased

quotes.name: Falkenrath Noble
quotes.flavor: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

quotes.name: Monstrous Growth
quotes.flavor: The nightstalkers' little game of tease-the-squirrel suddenly took an unexpected turn.

quotes.name: Firebreathing
quotes.flavor:
"Magic's only part of it, my friend. Diet does the rest."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

quotes.name: Woodwraith Strangler
quotes.flavor:
"Nothing could be more natural than roots sucking nourishment from the dead."
—Savra

quotes.name: Rhet-Crop Spearmaster
quotes.flavor: "In the afterlife, I'll have no need of sleep. And until then, I have no time for it!"

quotes.name: Dread Statuary
quotes.flavor: The last reliable landmark in Tazeem just walked away.

quotes.name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
quotes.flavor: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Compelling Argument
quotes.flavor:
"How can there be doubt in the presence of such blessings?"
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation

quotes.name: Captain Sisay
quotes.flavor: Her leadership forged the *Weatherlight*'s finest crew.

quotes.name: Foundry Inspector
quotes.flavor: It runs the junkyard like a well-oiled machine.

quotes.name: Sabretooth Tiger
quotes.flavor:
"I fear anything with teeth measured in handspans!"
—Norin the Wary

quotes.name: Auriok Windwalker
quotes.flavor: Each generation, a handful of Auriok girls are allowed to visit the Cave of Light. They return riding the wind and brandishing steel.

quotes.name: Scorned Villager // Moonscarred Werewolf
quotes.flavor: ". . . and I will bring the fury of the wild back to my village."

quotes.name: Hornet Cobra
quotes.flavor:
"Then inch by inch out of the grass rose up the head and spread hood of Nag, the big black cobra, and he was five feet long from tongue to tail."
—Rudyard Kipling, *The Jungle Books*

quotes.name: Cyclops Electromancer
quotes.flavor: Every storm has an eye.

quotes.name: Park Heights Pegasus
quotes.flavor: The burglar turned, bowed, and dropped from the ledge onto her waiting mount.

quotes.name: Aegis of the Heavens
quotes.flavor: Inner strength is never seen until it makes all the difference.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Negator
quotes.flavor: They exist to cease.

quotes.name: Deploy the Gatewatch
quotes.flavor: Gideon and Liliana may not have seen eye to eye, but that did not stop them from fighting side by side.

quotes.name: Steamflogger Service Rep
quotes.flavor: It's more like a hard day of lunch with a work break between shifts.

quotes.name: Monoist Sentry
quotes.flavor: Monoists fight a war of attrition, knowing their victory is inevitable so long as they stay true to their faith.

quotes.name: Laboratory Drudge
quotes.flavor:
"Many hands make light work."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

quotes.name: Thousand-Year Elixir
quotes.flavor: Was it a thousand years old, or would it make you live for a thousand years? The boggart didn't ask.

quotes.name: Phantom General
quotes.flavor: After his death, the general was reunited with fallen soldiers from over thirty of his campaigns.

quotes.name: Cruel Celebrant
quotes.flavor: "Whichever side wins, I'm sure the banquet will be superb."

quotes.name: Conspiracy
quotes.flavor:
"Those who don't stand with us, stand against us."
—Deimos

quotes.name: Spirit Mantle
quotes.flavor: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

quotes.name: Biorhythm
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen life's purpose, and now it is my own."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

quotes.name: Ogre Warrior
quotes.flavor: Assault and battery included.

quotes.name: Hulking Bugbear
quotes.flavor: Bugbears move with surprising speed for their size and bulk, a fact that has led to the demise of many unwary adventurers.

quotes.name: Angelic Chorus
quotes.flavor: The harmony of the glorious is a dirge to the wicked.

quotes.name: Demon Bolt
quotes.flavor:
"Burn them from the sky."
—Varragoth

quotes.name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
quotes.flavor: "Why so slow, why so slow? Hurry up! You never know what you'll find."

quotes.name: Cathartic Reunion
quotes.flavor: The soldier had given up his wealth, his title, even his home, but he had no room for regret. At last, he had saved his friend.

quotes.name: Kingfisher
quotes.flavor: It's tastiest when served with the fish it stole.

quotes.name: Lydia Frye
quotes.flavor:
"I would settle for the right to vote."
—Lydia, to Winston Churchill

quotes.name: Kin-Tree Severance
quotes.flavor:
"For his crimes—burn his blood and cut him from his ancestors. Perennation is only for family."
—Dictate of House Mevak in the banishment of Oret

quotes.name: Inspired Charge
quotes.flavor: "We are armed with light and steel. Who can stand against us?"

quotes.name: Auriok Champion
quotes.flavor: Mirrodin's deepest caverns conceal its brightest hopes.

quotes.name: Stern Dismissal
quotes.flavor: Cities offer tribute to Ephara and carve her image into their walls, imploring her to protect them from the dangers of the wild.

quotes.name: Gift of Fangs
quotes.flavor:
"You are one of the few to whom we offer our blessing. What fool would reject immortality?"
—Runo Stromkirk

quotes.name: Vindictive Vampire
quotes.flavor: In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "Considering your statures, let's start with the upward slash."

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Dead
quotes.flavor:
"They shall drink sorrow's dregs. They shall kill those whom once they loved."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Silverflame Ritual
quotes.flavor: Tempered by fire and united in virtue, the knights of Ardenvale fight with a single, unbreakable will.

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
quotes.flavor: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

quotes.name: Mascot Interception
quotes.flavor: Far from the trappings of royalty, Rowan and Will found inspiration from the most popular sport on campus, Mage Tower.

quotes.name: Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn // Hydaelyn, the Mothercrystal
quotes.flavor: "Show me your strength of will!"

quotes.name: Conspiracy Unraveler
quotes.flavor: INVARIABLY REACHES THE CORRECT CONCLUSION. CANNOT BE RUSHED.

quotes.name: Six-y Beast
quotes.flavor: Is it six?

quotes.name: Artful Takedown
quotes.flavor: Dimir assassinations are choreographed like dance routines. Each challenge is anticipated and countered with graceful ease.

quotes.name: Norn's Wellspring
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Drown, so you may breathe again."
—Atraxa

quotes.name: Razorfin Hunter
quotes.flavor: No one knew if they'd been lurking under the sea all along, or if they'd been created by the Phyrexian overlay.

quotes.name: Kiss of Death
quotes.flavor:
"I'd sooner lock lips with a viper. At least I might walk away from *that*."
—Elvish scout

quotes.name: Repulsive Mutation
quotes.flavor:
"Remind me to send the biomancer team a gift basket."
—Olana, Simic field researcher

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Greater Auramancy
quotes.flavor: A delicate veil of glamers can prove as sturdy as iron.

quotes.name: Primordial Sage
quotes.flavor: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.

quotes.name: Nightcreep
quotes.flavor:
"Please tell me I'm hallucinating. I'd rather be crazy than here."
—Gorev Hadszak, Wojek investigator

quotes.name: Archaeomancer
quotes.flavor: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

quotes.name: Arc Trail
quotes.flavor:
"Don't try to hit your enemies. Concentrate on the space between them, and fill the air with doom."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

quotes.name: Soulmender
quotes.flavor: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

quotes.name: Kess, Dissident Mage
quotes.flavor: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

quotes.name: Nightshade Stinger
quotes.flavor:
"Most faeries are harmless pranksters. Every now and again, though, you get one that crosses over from mischievous to malicious."
—Gaddock Teeg

quotes.name: Pillar of the Paruns
quotes.flavor:
"The Road goes ever on and on,
Down from the door where it began.
Now far ahead the Road has gone,
And I must follow, if I can."
—Frodo's song

quotes.name: Debt to the Deathless
quotes.flavor: Some of Orzhov's cruelest collectors remember their debtors by taste alone.

quotes.name: Sword of Vengeance
quotes.flavor: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

quotes.name: Ivory Crane Netsuke
quotes.flavor: It is said that the feathers of a crane are clouds, plucked and sewn together by the hands of the kami.

quotes.name: Goblin Warchief
quotes.flavor: Inspiration comes in all shapes and sizes.

quotes.name: Bloodthrone Vampire
quotes.flavor: Some humans willingly offered up their blood, hoping it would grant the vampire families the strength to stave off the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Portal to Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: After five thousand years, the nightmare returned.

quotes.name: Charge the Sanctum
quotes.flavor: Deep in their hearts, the team believed what was left of Jace could still be reasoned with.

quotes.name: Wall of Wood
quotes.flavor: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

quotes.name: Silent Sentinel
quotes.flavor: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

quotes.name: Serra Avenger
quotes.flavor:
"Those who endure in the face of suffering, those whose faith shines long in evil days, they shall see salvation."
—*Song of All*, canto 904

quotes.name: Thirst for Discovery
quotes.flavor: I knew he had left the castle now, and thought to use the opportunity to explore more than I had dared to do as yet.

quotes.name: Soulstone Sanctuary
quotes.flavor: By tradition, travelers touched the pillar for good luck. One day, it decided to travel as well.

quotes.name: Mossfire Valley
quotes.flavor: The battle at Ganzan Pass left the land so saturated with blood and twisted kami magic that it was a century before a single blade of grass could take root.

quotes.name: Favorable Winds
quotes.flavor:
"Like ribbons of wind and wisdom the coatls fly, twisting mystery into truth, shaping the clouds to suit their inscrutable will."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Ulvenwald Bear
quotes.flavor:
Out chasing bears
—Kessig expression meaning "died in the woods"

quotes.name: Majestic Metamorphosis
quotes.flavor: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.

quotes.name: Balduvian Barbarians
quotes.flavor:
"From the snowy slopes of Kaelor,
To the canyons of Bandu,
We drink and fight and feast and die
As we were born to do."
—Balduvian tavern song

quotes.name: Siege Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Hold the line, hold the li—"
—General Srok, last words

quotes.name: Living Wall
quotes.flavor: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

quotes.name: Brandywine Farmer
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Your land must be a realm of peace and content, and there must gardeners be in high honor."
—Faramir

quotes.name: Fungus Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"When a sliver of this breed enters the hive, the others claw each other in frenzied fits, thereby ensuring their rapid growth."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Triton Waverider
quotes.flavor: "You can no more stop me than you can halt the tide."

quotes.name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
quotes.flavor: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor:
"There's a rupture in time somewhere on board the ship. A small tear in the fabric of the continuum."
—The Eleventh Doctor

quotes.name: Call the Coppercoats
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: When the alarm crystals flash, Drannith's finest answer the call.

quotes.name: Dwarven Grunt
quotes.flavor:
Hard as stone and twice as stubborn.
—Dwarven compliment

quotes.name: Hunting Velociraptor
quotes.flavor:
"Clever girl."
—Robert Muldoon

quotes.name: Cover of Darkness
quotes.flavor: An Assassin has no weapon as deadly and no ally as dependable as the shroud of night.

quotes.name: Collective Blessing
quotes.flavor: Senators of Azorius often hired agents to spy on the Selesnya. They were told to record every spore and root they saw, as each could become a deadly foe.

quotes.name: The Howling Commandos
quotes.flavor:
"We've been fightin' this or that war our whole lives. And yeah, war is hell, but spend enough time in hell and you can fight like the devil."
—Dum Dum Dugan

quotes.name: Mantis Engine
quotes.flavor:
"It's a clever design. You should look closely at its gearing after it swallows your head."
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Azorius Herald
quotes.flavor:
"As peace should be—gentle yet unstoppable."
—Augustin IV

quotes.name: Invasion of Ergamon // Truga Cliffcharger
quotes.flavor: Throughout Ergamon's wild Truga Jungle, predator-prey relationships stopped until every last invader was crushed to dust.

quotes.name: Grindstone
quotes.flavor:
"Memory is a burden that wears at the soul as weather wears at stone."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Hitchclaw Recluse
quotes.flavor: Nearly invisible strands of web reach far beyond its lair to alert it of the approach of prey.

quotes.name: Thrilling Discovery
quotes.flavor:
"This must be the lost city of Zantafar, where my people lived before becoming nomads. Think of the history we'll learn here!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student

quotes.name: Dracogenesis
quotes.flavor:
"Let the dragonstorms rage. Let what seeks sustenance feed. Let Tarkir be what it was always meant to be."
—Sarkhan

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor: "Architectural Reconfiguration System. It reconstructs particles according to your needs," explained the Doctor. "A machine that makes machines?" Gregor questioned.

quotes.name: Goblin Matron
quotes.flavor: A mother only a child could love.
